acceptable_paraphrases: Rhombus with properties A and B
A rhombus that has property A and property B
The shape of a rhombus is defined by properties A and B
critical_errors: inconsistent use of letter case for concepts
misconceptions: confusing a rhombus with other quadrilaterals (e.g., square, parallelogram)
mentioning only one property instead of both
grading_notes: Ensure that the answer includes both concepts A and B in relation to a rhombus. Acceptable variations should still convey the correct meaning.
